subject.title: fix(matrix): deliver reasoning blocks as m.notice when /reasoning on [AI-assisted]

question: After the current-main rebase uses `reasoningPayloadsEnabled`, should this PR require live Matrix/Element proof before merge or is the in-memory Matrix adapter proof enough?
rationale: The repository proof policy asks for real behavior proof for external PRs, but the contributor says they lack Matrix homeserver credentials and the code-path proof is otherwise fairly targeted.

options.title: Require live Matrix proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Matrix/Element send-read output, logs, or a short recording before merge.

options.title: Accept source-path proof
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly waive live transport proof after the branch is rebased and the code defect is fixed.

recommendation.title: Require live Matrix proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Matrix/Element send-read output, logs, or a short recording before merge.
